title: Caravel Trade
summary: Caravel Trade has progressed from its October 14 README-only listing to implemented Rust templates, TypeScript integration and a creator-reported Esmeralda deployment. The October 23 source describes full-order TARI/cUSD trades, owner cancellation and a 1% fee split: 0.7% Caravel, 0.3% burn. cUSD is a test token with no value. The public app reaches wallet creation or recovery before Trade; no wallet was created and no order was placed. Source now builds against template_lib 0.35 and test tooling 0.47; deployed templates retain their older 0.46.1 build according to the maintainer. Recording is a README walkthrough, not a trade. Original repository discovery and earlier concept footage are retained.
creator: okansaglam016161-pixel
cardSummary: Explore private peer-to-peer orders exchanging testnet TARI and cUSD, with full-order fills and owner cancellation.

recording.credit: Source/docs walkthrough — Updated README, implementation and deployment documentation; no wallet or trade.
